steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Drain and rinse the cooked chickpeas, then pat them dry with a clean cloth.
Mash the cooked chickpeas in a large bowl until mostly smooth with some texture remaining.
Finely grate the cooked carrot and mince the garlic clove; add both to the bowl.
Add the chickpea flour, coconut milk, ground cumin, and turmeric; stir until a firm dough forms.
Shape the mixture into 12 equal patties, each about 1.5 cm thick, and place on the lined sheet.
Brush the tops of the patties lightly with olive oil.
Bake for 20 to 22 minutes, flipping once at 11 minutes, until golden and firm to the touch.
Cool for 5 minutes before serving. Yield: 12 patties · 4 family portions. Refrigerate for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 1 month.
